data.name: Hôtel Village Soleil - La Marina
data.address: Rte de la Marina, Le Gosier 97190, Guadeloupe
data.description:
On a hill overlooking the Caribbean Sea, this relaxed hotel is 1 km from the Aquarium de Guadeloupe, 3 km from the 18th-century Fort Fleur d'épée and 9 km from Pointe-à-Pitre International Airport.
Down-to-earth rooms include free Wi-Fi and TVs, plus kitchenettes (some outdoor), and balconies or terraces; some have sea views. Suites add living areas with pull-out sofas, and/or loft bedrooms.
Amenities include a casual open-air restaurant, and an outdoor pool surrounded by gardens and palm trees. Breakfast is offered for a fee.
